sections.title: New
notes: Play pages on the website show what the play would have scored in Etterna (Wife3, J4 to J9) and osu! stable (any OD).

sections.title: Improved
notes: The data folder now has an empty skins folder from the start, so it's easy to find where downloaded skins go.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: played=yes in the song list search now finds charts you've played at any rate, not just the current one.
Dragging osu! beatmaps, song packs, skins and folders onto the game window works again on Windows.
Charts no longer sometimes start from the song preview point instead of the beginning after you go back to the song list and play again.

sections.title: New
notes: Japanese, Korean and Chinese characters in song titles and names now display.
Move the FPS counter, accuracy, average error, performance prediction, judgement counter and song progress bar anywhere on screen with their X and Y position settings in Options.

Skins can now set which elements are shown, the lane width, judgement line height, judgement and combo heights, hit timing bar and the positions above. In Options these are grouped under Element Visibility and Element Positions, which show the skin's value until you change it. Delete puts one setting back to the skin's value, and Reset all to skin default resets a whole section.

Options is reorganized so related settings sit together: Window, Gameplay, Audio, Calibration, Skin, Element Visibility, Element Positions, Keys, Online, Library and About. Scroll speed is now under Gameplay, and Discord rich presence under Online.

Skins can now do a lot more: lane backgrounds, a light up each lane while a key is held, stage borders, lane separators, a judgement line and a lane cover image; note colours by beat snap like StepMania and Etterna noteskins; separate hold images while held and a colour for dropped holds; grade, progress bar and timing bar images with early and late colours; judgement and pressed receptor animations that play once from the start; and layout values per key count. See the skinning guide for the new image names.
Click a play on the song list leaderboard to see its results screen, and press F5 on any results screen to watch the replay.
Press your restart key (` by default) on the results screen to play the chart again.
Watch replays from 0.25x to 2x speed with the up and down arrows, or click the speed at the bottom of the screen.
New song list sorts: recently played and best accuracy.
The song list leaderboards now scroll and show up to 100 plays each. Press Shift+Tab, or click the hint under them, to switch to a performance leaderboard that covers every rate.
Hold Shift while changing scroll speed in options to change it 1 at a time.
Song and pack downloads now show their progress at the top of the song list.

sections.title: Improved
notes: Smoother gameplay: changing numbers like accuracy, combo, judgement counts and the FPS counter no longer cause small stutters, and long holds and busy charts cost less to draw.
The FPS counter updates four times a second, so it's easier to read.
Big song libraries use far less memory, load faster and no longer freeze the song list when a download finishes or a pack is added.
Changing the rate while sorting or searching by difficulty no longer freezes the game; difficulties fill in as they're calculated.
Typing in the song list search is faster, and so are local leaderboards, deleting songs and the end of a play.
Songs start faster when you pick them from the song list, and title screen songs and song backgrounds load in the background without hitches.
Totals on the website, like play and chart counts, can take up to 30 seconds to update.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: The song list preview for 1K, 2K and 3K charts no longer stretches the columns wider than they are for 4K.

StepMania, Etterna and osu! charts that can't be played correctly are no longer loaded: ones with negative or impossibly high BPMs, notes before the song starts, notes that start during a hold in the same column, or notes in the same column 5 ms or less apart. Rolls play as long notes and mines are left out. Your song library rescans once after updating to pick up the change.

sections.title: New
notes: A judgement counter that shows how many of each judgement you've hit while you play. Turn it on with Judgement counter in Options.
The hit timing bar has a marker for the average of your last 20 hits, so you can see whether you're drifting early or late. Turn it off with Hit timing average in Options.
The song preview has a progress bar along the bottom. Click or drag it to jump to any part of the song.
Report a bug in Options opens a bug report on GitHub and the folder with your log file, so you can attach it.
Type in Options to search your settings, like you can in the song list. Esc clears the search.
Choose which speakers or headphones the game plays through with Output device in Options. If that device isn't plugged in, the game uses the system default.
Sort the song list by Long notes density (F8).

On Windows, Display mode in Options has Windowed, Fullscreen and Borderless window, and changes right away. Borderless window covers the screen without taking it over the way fullscreen can, which should help with alt-tab and screen sharing. Fullscreen monitor picks which screen fullscreen and borderless use.
Report cheaters, offensive names and broken charts with the Report button on play, player and chart pages on the website.
Join the Discord in Options opens the Nascent Discord server.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: StepMania and Etterna charts no longer turn lift notes into extra presses, which made some charts harder and rated higher than they should be. Your song library rescans once after updating to pick up the fix.

sections.title: New
notes: Play StepMania and Etterna charts (.sm, .ssc and .dwi). Link your Etterna Songs folder in Options, or any folder of song packs.

The chart menu (F7) shows the chart's file format and whether it's from a linked folder or your Nascent songs folder, and has an Open chart folder button. Charts in linked folders can't be deleted from the menu.
The song list shows a progress bar at the top while it loads charts or calculates difficulties in the background.
Drag a song pack .zip, like an Etterna or StepMania pack, onto the window to import it.

Download Etterna charts from the chart browser. They come in EtternaOnline packs, so the browser tells you how many songs the pack has and how big it is, and downloads the whole pack when you confirm.

sections.title: Improved
notes: Linked folders in Options show their full path instead of only the last two folders.
The chart menu's delete options are now Delete this difficulty, Delete all difficulties and Delete pack, which removes a whole song pack such as one downloaded from EtternaOnline.

The chart browser only lists charts it can download, ranked or not. Its Downloadable only and Status options are replaced by a Source option for osu! or Etterna charts, and it now sorts by title, with a Sort by option for artist, difficulty, length, plays, newest or keys.

sections.title: Fixed
notes: Plays on some charts with extreme scroll speed gimmicks couldn't be submitted.

sections.title: New
notes: Link other song folders, like your osu! Songs folder, so you can play those charts without copying them.
Skins can now change almost everything about how the game looks.
Skins can animate any image and can use different settings and images for each key count.
Export, delete and import skins.
When a skin has a mistake in it, Nascent tells you what's wrong as soon as you pick it.
Note opacity and Receptor opacity settings in Options.
Change the volume anywhere with Alt and the mouse wheel, or Alt and Up or Down.
Press F7 on the results screen to open your replay on the website.
An Instant restart option in Options under Keys, so the restart key restarts straight away instead of needing to be held.
Press Shift and F2 to go back to the song you had before shuffling.
Sort the song list by key count.
Press Ctrl and F5 on the song list to reload every chart and recalculate every difficulty.
A Credits screen and changelog, both in Options under About.
Replays have a seek bar at the bottom.

sections.title: Improved
notes: Big song folders load much faster. After the first launch the song list opens almost straight away, and new or changed songs are picked up in the background.
The loading bar on the title screen now covers every step of loading your songs, so it no longer sits full while the game is still working.
Picking a song on a slow drive no longer freezes the game. The song loads in the background and its preview starts as soon as it's ready.
Scrollbars on the song list and in Options can be clicked and dragged.
The results screen's hit error graph is labelled Early and Late.
Clearing a search keeps the song you had selected, even when the search had no results.
The account screen opens on Create account the first time, and both forms have a button to submit them.
Creating an account asks you to type your password twice.
Sign up errors explain exactly what's wrong with the username or password.
A newly imported skin shows up in the Options skin list right away.

sections.title: Fixed
notes: Songs you deleted can be downloaded again.
Notes and other images drawn small no longer have a sliver of their right or bottom edge cut off.

sections.title: Online
notes: The website's download button has a menu with the downloads for every platform.
Very old versions of the game are now told to update before their plays can be submitted.
